name: prunus amygdalus dulcis (sweet almond) oil + ricinus communis (castor) seed oil + vitis vinifera (grape) seed extract
purpose: Purpose 1. Reduce the impact of microorganisms on nails, deeply clean nails and surrounding skin, especially nail seams, and reduce odor and itching. 2. A variety of plant essential oils go directly to the nail bed, reducing nail discoloration and helping the nails returm to their normal color and shape. 3. Soothes, softens and moisturizes nails, reduces dryness, cuticles, hangnails and nail breakage. 4. It is easy and quick to use, restores nail luster and repairs damaged nails.
uses: 1. Clean and dry nails and surrounding skin. 2. Use the nail file to remove excess cuticle and dirt. 3. Take appropriate amount of essence and apply it evenly on nails. 4. Massage gently with your hands in circular motions for absorption.
otcwarn: Do not use Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. STOP USE Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
